caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical mug with a handle, placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The mug is rendered in a reddish-brown color with visible shading and highlights, suggesting a metallic or glazed ceramic surface. The rim of the mug has a slightly thicker edge, and there is a faint horizontal groove about halfway down its height, indicating a subtle decorative or structural detail. The handle is attached just below the rim and curves downward, also colored in the same reddish-brown with areas of shadow. The base of the mug is darker, with more pronounced shading. There is a signature, "P. West," located in the lower right quadrant of the image, below the mug.
title: Earthenware Mug
